title: Marcos Jr. tells BuCor: No special treatment, end illegal drug trade in prisons

blocks.text: MANILA — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday ordered the Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) to ensure fair treatment of persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) and put an end to the illegal drug trade inside correctional facilities.
